Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Being between the ages of 18-60
  -  To accept voluntary participation in the study
  -  Spastic Hemiplegia (Modified Ashworth Scale 2 and above)
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Pregnant women, breastfeeding  [AND] and younger than 18 years
  -  To have medication  [OR] and substance use causing neuropathy in the history of the disease  [OR] and / or neuropathy
